description: This file implements the core functions for Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) system, including creation, destruction, session management, and querying capabilities. It interacts with external components such as ActiveSessions, Logger, and MediaKeysCapabilitiesBackend to manage DRM sessions and support key systems like PlayReady.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system
methods.description: Creates an OpenCDM system instance based on the provided key system string, logs the commit ID, and calls extended creation function.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system_extended
methods.description: Initializes a new OpenCDM system object with the specified key system.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_system
methods.description: Deletes the OpenCDM system object if it exists.

methods.name: opencdm_is_type_supported
methods.description: Checks if the specified key system and MIME type are supported.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the system; currently sets size to zero.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the key system supported by the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_drm_time
methods.description: Gets the DRM time from the system.

methods.name: opencdm_get_system_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session associated with a key ID from the active sessions.

methods.name: opencdm_system_set_server_certificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate; currently a stub returning success.

methods.name: opencdm_get_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session for a given key ID, delegating to system session retrieval.

methods.name: opencdm_construct_session
methods.description: Constructs a new DRM session, initializes it, and generates a request if not PlayReady.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session
methods.description: Removes the session from active sessions, effectively destructing it.

methods.name: opencdm_session_load
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a session; currently sets size to zero.

methods.name: opencdm_session_id
methods.description: Returns the session ID string.

methods.name: opencdm_session_buffer_id
methods.description: Returns null, placeholder for buffer ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_has_key_id
methods.description: Checks if the session contains a specific key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_status
methods.description: Returns the status of a key within the session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_error
methods.description: Placeholder for session error code, not implemented.

methods.name: opencdm_session_system_error
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_update
methods.description: Updates a session with a license message.

methods.name: opencdm_session_remove
methods.description: Removes a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_resetoutputprotection
methods.description: Stub for resetting output protection, not implemented.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_parameter
methods.description: Stub for setting session parameters, not implemented.

methods.name: opencdm_session_close
methods.description: Closes a session.
